projects.title: දැනුමට සවියක්
projects.description:
රුඳුරැ වූ කාලගුණයෙන් ආපදාවට පත්, සිප් කිරුළු දරන්නට වෙර දරන අපේම සහෝදර සහෝදරියන්ගේ අහිමි වූ අධ්‍යාපන සිහිනය නැවත පණ පොවන්නට,
*බද්දේගම ලියෝ සමාජය සහ ගාල්ල රිච්මන්ඩ් විද්‍යාලයීය ලියෝ සමාජය* එක්ව සංවිධානය කරන ලද *දැනුමට සවියක්* ව්‍යාපෘතිය සාර්ථකව පසුගිය දින නිමාවට පත් කරන ලදී.
ඒ සඳහා අප හා එක්ව මෙම මහඟු කර්තව්‍යට දායක වූ ඔබ සියලු දෙනාටම අපගේ හදපිරි ප්‍රණාමය පුද කර සිටින්නෙමු.🦁❤️

projects.title: Alms Giving
projects.description:
With gratitude in our hearts, we are happy to announce the successful conclusion of Project Alms Giving. 🙏

On this sacred Poya Day, we had the privilege of practicing true dāna by serving Upāsaka Dāna to devotees, sharing not just a meal but also compassion, kindness, and the values of Buddhism. 🌕🤍

This project reminded us that service is not measured by scale, but by sincerity. We extend our heartfelt thanks to everyone who supported, contributed, and stood with us to make this meaningful initiative a success.

May the merits of this noble act be shared with all.
Service before self always. 🕊️

executive.name: Leo Mevinu Gamage
executive.description: Leo Mevinu Gamage leads the club's reactivation in 2025/26, taking the helm as the 9th generation president of the Centennial Leo Club. Under his leadership, the club has rejoined the fold under the newly redistricted Leo District 306 D8, carrying forward the club's proud tradition of service, achievement, and community impact.

affiliatedBodies.label: GLOBAL MOVEMENT
affiliatedBodies.title: Leo Movement
affiliatedBodies.description: Sponsored by Lions Clubs International, the Leo Movement is the world’s largest youth-led service organization, spanning over 140 countries. Built on the pillars of Leadership, Experience, and Opportunity, it empowers youth aged 12 to 30 to serve their communities while fostering global fellowship. Through diverse social service initiatives, Leos transform today’s volunteers into the responsible leaders of tomorrow.

affiliatedBodies.label: GOVERNING BODY
affiliatedBodies.title: Leo Multiple District 306
affiliatedBodies.description: Leo Multiple District 306 is the governing body overseeing 12 Leo Districts across Sri Lanka and the Maldives. Since the movement’s island-wide inception in 1969, the Council has unified over 200 clubs to foster leadership and service excellence. It provides a strategic framework for thousands of young leaders to collaborate, share resources, and create a collective national impact.

affiliatedBodies.label: OUR SPONSORING CLUB
affiliatedBodies.title: The Lions Club of Galle Karapitiya
affiliatedBodies.description: The Lions Club of Galle Karapitiya, inaugurated in 2011,  has been the dedicated sponsor and mentor of our Leo Club since our inauguration in 2016. Under the 2025/2026 leadership of President Lion Lakma Kithmini MJF MAF, the Club provides the essential guidance and "We Serve" spirit that empowers our members to lead with purpose. Their steadfast support forms the foundation of our success, helping us create a lasting positive impact in our community.
